name: South Ridge / Southeast Ridge

waypoints.name: Ross Dam Trailhead
waypoints.note: SR-20 parking near milepost 134; self-issue NPS wilderness permit required well ahead for Big Beaver/Ross Lake camps before starting.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR 20, the North Cascades Highway, to the Ross Dam Trailhead parking lot near milepost 134, a few miles east of Diablo. Overnight stays need a North Cascades backcountry permit.

waypoints.name: Big Beaver Trail junction (via Ross Dam)
waypoints.note: Cross Ross Dam and follow the Ross Lake shoreline to the Big Beaver Trail junction; Ross Lake Resort's water taxi to Big Beaver Landing can bypass this shoreline stretch.
waypoints.directions: Descend the trail steeply about 0.8 mile to a gravel service road, go left briefly, then turn right down to Ross Dam. Cross the dam and follow the trail north along the west shore of Ross Lake about 6 miles to Big Beaver Creek and the Big Beaver Trail junction. A water taxi to Big Beaver Landing skips this shoreline stretch.

waypoints.name: Thirtynine Mile Creek Camp
waypoints.note: Tent sites on the west bank, stock/horse camp on the east bank of Thirtynine Mile Creek; the last reliable running water and last legal campsite before leaving the trail.
waypoints.directions: Turn west up the Big Beaver Trail and follow it about 5 miles up the valley through old-growth forest to Thirtynine Mile Creek and its camp, the last reliable water and last legal campsite before leaving the trail.

waypoints.name: Off-trail departure onto Thirtynine Mile Ridge
waypoints.note: Leave Big Beaver Trail between the creek crossing and the 'Thirtynine Mile Creek Camp' marker post, climbing north through a brushy gully and adjacent rib — reported as a horrible bushwhack low down.
waypoints.directions: Leave the Big Beaver Trail between the Thirtynine Mile Creek crossing and the camp marker post, heading north into a brushy gully.

waypoints.name: Point 6071, Thirtynine Mile Ridge crest
waypoints.note: Ridge crest gained here; travel eases to open Class 1-2 walking above this point after steep timber and brush below.
waypoints.directions: Climb north up the brushy gully and the rib beside it, a hard bushwhack through steep timber and brush where most of the day's gain happens, until you break out on the crest of Thirtynine Mile Ridge.

waypoints.name: Saddle camp below Point 6690, South Ridge
waypoints.note: Informal saddle campsite used to split the climb into two days; no running water — carry up from Thirtynine Mile Creek.
waypoints.directions: Follow the crest north through open forest and then open walking to the saddle at about 6,600 ft where the rib meets the south ridge. There is no water here; carry it up from Thirtynine Mile Creek.

waypoints.name: Points 7361 and 7547 (false summits)
waypoints.note: Exposed rocky high points along the crest before the true summit; the descent requires down-climbing short Class 3 steps here in reverse.
waypoints.directions: Follow the crest north at Class 1-2 over the rounded Point 6690 to the rocky Point 7361 and on to Point 7547, the top of the north-south ridgeline. Watch for cornices early in the season.

waypoints.name: Mount Prophet summit
waypoints.note: True summit reached via a short Class 3 rock scramble on the final southeast ridge; exposure is present but never bad.
waypoints.directions: Point 7547 is a false summit. Turn west a short distance from it; the last few feet to the true summit are a short, steep Class 3 scramble with moderate exposure.

itinerary: Typically a 2-3 day trip: hike or water-taxi in to the Thirtynine Mile Creek area, high camp near 6,700 ft on the south ridge crest, summit day via the ridge, then exit back down Big Beaver Trail.
